title: Hydragen layer manifest
description: Content requirements for parsed YAML/YML, TOML, JSON, or JSONC layer manifests. Validation is offline and does not check filenames, locations, source existence, or relationships between layers.
$comment: The name-policy fingerprint approves friendly diagnostics only, using SHA-256 of the compact JSON array [layerName, layerNameSyntax] with sorted object keys. Review the guidance before renewing approval; stale approval leaves validity unchanged and retains generic structured failures.

layerNameSyntax.$comment: Shared name prefix grammar for standalone names and published references. The caller constrains the suffix and full-name length. The negative character-class lookahead denotes the absolute end, including after newlines.

layerName.description: Use lowercase ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores, or hyphens, optionally as @scope/name; at most 214 characters in the complete name. Unscoped names and scopes cannot start with a dot or underscore; scoped package names can.

exactVersionSuffix.$comment: Strict SemVer 2.0.0 at the start of a version or after the published-reference separator. Build identifiers may contain leading zeroes; numeric prerelease identifiers may not.

localReference.description: An explicit local path: ., .., ./, ../, an absolute slash path, or recognisable Windows relative, rooted, drive, UNC, or device syntax. Path text is preserved; native interpretation is separate.

publishedReference.$comment: Only the name prefix, not the whole reference, has the 214-character bound. The shared name grammar and exact version suffix exclude additional separators.

authorEmail.description: A syntactically valid email address; no mailbox or ownership check is performed.

authorUrl.description: An absolute URI with a scheme; no reachability or ownership check is performed.

author.$comment: Conditional branches preserve useful nested failures instead of hiding them behind a generic union error. String authors remain literal, arbitrary non-blank strings on load.

nonBlankString.$comment: The optional x-hydragen-nonblank-pattern-sha256 annotation approves friendly non-blank diagnostics only. It is the lowercase SHA-256 of the decoded pattern string encoded as UTF-8. Missing or mismatched approval leaves validation unchanged and uses generic pattern diagnostics. Do not automatically update this token when changing the pattern; update it only after reviewing that the rule still means Unicode non-blank.
nonBlankString.description: A string containing at least one character outside Unicode White_Space. Accepted strings are not trimmed or otherwise normalized.

$schema.description: Optional schema URL or relative path used by an editor or validator.

name.description: The layer's declared name, without normalization or registry-specific reserved-name exclusions.

author.description: Optional person or organisation credited with authoring the layer: a non-blank string, or an object with required name and optional email and url. This is descriptive metadata, not a verified identity.

dependencies.description: Ordered source references. Omission and an empty array both mean no dependencies; order does not yet define rendering precedence.

description.description: Optional short explanation of what the layer provides or is used for. When supplied, this must be a non-blank string.
